At Mission Masala Antwerp, Gent and Brussels we're looking for a motivated & eager person to join our team. Are you an experienced cook that can stand the heat?
 

Chef De Partie : Tandoor & bbq chef
 
 

• Experience in independent cooking with a tandoor oven & bbq. 

• Cut and marinate meat and vegetables - Kebab, Tikka, ... 

• Making dough for different types of (Indian) bread - Naan, Roti, Bhatura, Roomali Roti, Paratha, ... 

• Determining food inventory need, stocking & ordering. 

• Respect all HACCP guidelines at all times. 

• Operate a smooth and efficient service and handovers to the next shift. 

• Ensure that food comes out simultaneously, in high quality and on time. 

• Comply with nutritional and sanitary regulations and safety standards. 

• Maintain a positive and professional approach with colleagues and clients. 

• Accuracy and speed in executing assigned commands. 
 

• At least 2 years experience in a professional kitchen 

• Excellent knowledge of Indian cuisine 

• Must be a true passionate foodie 

• Good level of English both spoken & written. Dutch skills are an asset. 

• Strong in communication 

• Team player & trouble-shooter 

• Responsible, Social & humorous 

• Knowledge of HACCP 

• Able to multitask and work efficiently under pressure

PROPELLING INNOVATION WITH YOU!!!!  
  
 Would you like to join one of the best specialized PLM consulting and system integration firm that works closely with its clients to accelerate business transformation using its unique approach based in product lifecycle management (PLM) - which combines consulting, integration and managed services?  
  
 If yes, this position is for YOU!!!  
  
 As part of our current growth, we are looking for an HR assistant for Europe Zone
 

Job Description
 
 

• Work with lead HR Europe, based in France (Paris), to manage all cross countries HR processes and provide operational & administrative support  
 

• Countries: France, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Sweden 

• Consolidate the Performance Management cycle data at Europe level – Build & contribute to run all the related HR plans (annual assessment interviews, salary reviews, development plans, training plans)  

• Prepare all appropriate HR documents such as letter, employment contracts and ad hoc correspondences  

• Support the HR Personal administration tasks and lead some of the processes with external partners / providers (payroll coordination, follow up on fringe benefits, individual files,…) and maintain all the HR tracking database (Training plan, work permits, medical checkup, Health Insurance registration, Paid leaves….) 

• Support and run the onboarding process for new comers in the countries  

• Ensure the Processia HR academy regular follow up (eLearning platform) and propose appropriate communication to promote the content 

• Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects  

The Successful Applicant
 
 

• Job Skills  
 

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR in France, UK, Belgium or Netherlands. Ideally familiar with French social legislation 

• Small and fast-paced environment/companies first experience (“PME”) 

• Strong computer skills (Excel and Powerpoint as a must).  

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus   

·
 Behavioral skills: 
 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to build solid relationships with employees, positive open attitude, team spirit.
 

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure

Connaissance Générales et Ressources Humaines

Obtain and maintain the product certifications (for panels ) required to allow the business to operate in all
market segments. These certifications cover product properties as insulation values, reaction and
resistance to fire, environmental performance and mechanical properties as span and structural strength.
They are obtained through as mix of calculations, internal and 3rd party testing.

Main Objectives

 

• Contact with external bodies for testing and certification. Mounting samples and testing.
• Drafting technical files and CAD-drawings and control the mechanical properties are met to comply with the claims we make. Creating solutions to obtain certifications and/or successful tests.
• Place orders and approve invoices for external services. (60%)
• Provide technical assistance and support for bigger construction jobs the company supplies product into (25%)
• Assist in meetings on Kingspan group level, personal trainings and travel (10%)
• Assist in product audits in our factories. Provide auditors the requested samples, data and statistics
• regarding the manufactured products. (5%)
• Make a monthly reporting on the progress. This report is reviewed in the monthly Certification Meeting
• and/or the R&D Meeting and/or the monthly Operations Meeting.
• Reporting to the Certification and Compliance Director.
• Led by our Group Head of Compliance & Certification, a new product compliance programme is being
• rolled out across the Group to the incoming ISO 37301 Compliance Management standard, which will be audited by our Group Internal Auditing function with reporting to the Board’s Audit & Compliance Committee. Every employee of the certification department has to follow an ISO 37301 training and
• comply with the compliance rules.

Who you are

 

• Knowledge of building materials preferred.
• Master degree in civil engineering of bachelor with experience.
• Able to work independently and self-organized.
• You have a good knowledge of English and Dutch; basic German or French is a plus.

•  

At least

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?
